original.statement: istio-iptables re-executions now skip the apply step when existing iptables rules are compatible.

decision.reason: [ev-b0388a31bd06] says the istio-iptables binary now handles re-runs by skipping the apply step when the existing rules are compatible. This is a runtime change in how the binary behaves, with no new configuration involved, so behavior-changed is the right change type. A protocol-behavior subject with component istio-iptables and a kebab-case name taken from the note's own words is the closest identity that fits. The family and name are judgement calls rather than something the note states, so confidence is low.
